serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: ComplianceAide is an evidence-cited, human-approved SaaS compliance copilot for cybersecurity and regulatory readiness. The service connects to customer-approved evidence in governed repositories such as SharePoint; evaluates evidence clarity, recency, traceability, and sufficiency; maps evidence to applicable controls and framework requirements; identifies unsupported, partial, stale, missing, or conflicting evidence; and produces source-linked, review-ready assessments, reports, policies, control narratives, System Security Plan (SSP) support, Security Assessment Report (SAR) support, Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) entries, validation matrices, and executive readiness briefs. A named human reviewer approves, revises, rejects, or requests additional evidence before work product is accepted. ComplianceAide supports FedRAMP and NIST SP 800-53 readiness and package-preparation workflows; it does not replace an independent assessor or Authorizing Official, make authorization decisions, or currently represent a FedRAMP-authorized cloud service offering.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Public ComplianceAide Trust & Safety Portal covering platform scope, customer-data boundaries, Microsoft Azure hosting, security controls, framework readiness, incident response, continuity, and responsible disclosure.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Primary ComplianceAide One Stop Shop for 2026. The authenticated SharePoint hub contains the SAM.gov registration packet, active UEI and CAGE evidence, entity and governance records, security working materials, source-referenced solution briefs, and controlled package-preparation materials. Access does not imply that every document is part of the final FedRAMP certification boundary or submission package.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Request least-privilege access from the ComplianceAid INC. package owner. Access is limited to authorized company personnel, assessors, reviewers, and government stakeholders with a documented need.
